study.title: Phase 2 study of an investigational therapy
study.brief_summary: Randomized study evaluating efficacy and safety.

pci.methodology: Fixed-reference descriptive PCI (0–100): eligibility 25%, primary outcomes 20%, secondary outcomes 20%, arms 15%, enrollment 10%, text complexity 10%. Fixed component ceilings: 40, 10, 20, 8, 1000, 20 respectively. Missing, invalid and non-finite components contribute zero and are disclosed in missing_fields, so incomplete records may be understated. Clip each normalized component to [0,1]; sum unrounded weighted terms; round the total to two decimals, exact decimal half-up. Categorize the rounded score: Low <40, Medium 40–70 inclusive, High >70. These are explicit research assumptions, not a clinically validated score, clinical thresholds, causal forecasts or duration probabilities. Training-relative research PCI is a separate methodology.
